info.title: Coverage Stream API
info.description: DRAFT - NOT PUBLISHED. Backend API contract for pushing live station patrol coverage to the control room dashboard and the steward app over Server-Sent Events (ADR 0011). Every event carries the coverage of ALL stations, the same payload a client receives on connect, so a client always replaces its whole state instead of merging updates.

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream (text/event-stream). Every message is an SSE event named `coverage` whose `data` is a JSON-encoded array of StationCoverage, one per station. The first event after connecting contains the coverage as of the last refresh; each following event contains the full coverage of one refresh, recomputed when a positioning or patrol session event arrives and on a timer, because coverage also expires with time (ADR 0010). The stream stays open until the client disconnects; EventSource reconnects receive a fresh first event, so a client that missed events resynchronizes by replacing its whole state.

200.description: Open SSE stream. Each event's data is a CoverageSnapshot.

500.description: Internal server error before the stream was opened

CoverageSnapshot.description: The coverage of every station at one moment. Every event on the stream carries the full snapshot, never a single station.

station_id.description: Identifier of the station. The client keys its state by this id.

status.description: Rollup for the whole station: overdue if any area is overdue, compliant otherwise.

areas.description: Patrol areas of this station. Concourse and platform are evaluated independently (ADR 0010), so a station can hold both a compliant and an overdue area.

area_id.description: Identifier of the patrol area, unique within its station.

type.description: Kind of area. Decides how long a visit must last to count as a patrol.

covered_now.description: True while a qualifying visit is still open, so the area counts as patrolled right now.

stewards_present.description: Identifiers of the stewards currently at this area, qualified or not. Empty when nobody is present.

last_covered_at.description: End of the newest finished qualifying visit. Null when the area has never been patrolled. UTC in ISO 8601.

status.description: Compliant when a qualifying patrol exists within the last rolling sixty minutes (ADR 0010), overdue otherwise.

overdue_at.description: The absolute moment the area becomes (or became) overdue. Clients count down to it themselves between events. Null while covered_now is true, or when the area was never patrolled and has no deadline. UTC in ISO 8601.

as_of.description: When this verdict was computed. The verdict is true for exactly this moment; clients can show the age of their data with it. UTC in ISO 8601.

message.description: Human-readable error message intended for developers
